app.name: QR Mii
app.short_description: Converts Wii Miis to scannable Mii QR codes
app.long_description: Reads raw Wii Mii files from sd:/miis/in, converts each to a 3DS-compatible Mii QR code, and saves the result as a BMP image in sd:/miis/out so it can be scanned by a 3DS, Wii U, or Nintendo Switch 2's Mii Maker.
